text.p: Following are the main stories in Slovenia's Monday morning newspapers:
- Slovenia has "nice chances" to become a non-permanent member of the UN Security Council for the next two years, Slovenian diplomatic sources said.
- Four people died in traffic accidents on Slovenian roads over the weekend.
- The government said it will discuss the country's draft budget on Thursday despite rightist Social Democrat threats to demand a no-confidence vote if the budget is not in parliament by Monday.
- Damages to Slovenian farms caused by weather this year reached 20 billion tolars ($122 million), Slovenia's Minister of Agriculture Ciril Smrkolj said.
- 85 percent of Slovenia's high-school students graduated in the first attempt, the Ministry of Education said.
